title: BODY-CONTENTS
summary: Second contents sheet for the body assembly section (UPC 1, sheets F1-F32, G1, M1-M7): convertible top and rear deck lid locks, windshield and reveal moldings, roof panels (T-tops) with locks, trim, weatherstrips and stowage, rear window and its stowage and locks, rear grille and plenum air door, outside mirror and emblems, sill plates, rear filler panel and tail pipe bezels, fuel filler door, seat belts and shoulder harness, carpets and insulators, body mounts, and heater/defroster/vacuum controls and ducts. A car drawing points to where each sheet's parts sit.
notes_internal: Drawing: convertible top at left (F1-F7), coupe at right with sheet boxes on the roof, windshield, rear window, rear deck, doors, floor and heater; 'F11 THRU F14' box on the roof panels.
F19 title partly under the binder hole: printed 'RR. WDO L' ... 'S' (likely LOCKS, not inferred); written with '?' for the hidden letters.
F28 title partly under the binder hole: 'FRT. CARPETS & INSULA' ... 'RS'; written with '?'.
Rev 1 date: first character covered by a strike line; '?-16-69'.
Title block: drawing 3965172, DR DP/C1, CK 4-18-69 C1, PREL 3-21-69, C/O D2, model 19000. 'K73' printed sideways at left.
